href=\"/wqmt/%E6%8A%BD%E5%8D%A1%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E5%99%A8\" title=\"抽卡模拟器\"><span class=\"nav-show-model-panel_btn\">抽卡模拟器</span></a>\n</p>\n</div></div>\n<div class=\"panel-group\" id=\"mc_accordion-1\">\n<div class=\"panel panel-info\"><div class=\"panel-heading\"><span class=\"clearfix show paneltitle\" data-toggle=\"collapse\" data-parent=\"#mc_accordion-1\" data-target=\"#mc_collapse-1\"><span class=\"panel-title pull-left\"><span style=\"font-weight:bold;color: #31708f\">特别注意</span></span><span class=\"badge pull-right\">展开/折叠</span></span></div><div id=\"mc_collapse-1\" class=\"panel-body panel-collapse collapse\">\n<ul><li>各类型卡池间保底计数不共用，<span style=\"color:#be4bdb\"><b>限定追踪</b></span>和<span style=\"color:#be4bdb\"><b>返场·限定追踪</b></span>同样不共用，<span style=\"color:#32145a\"><b>联动追踪</b></span>和<span style=\"color:#32145a\"><b>复刻·联动追踪</b></span>同样不共用。</li>\n<li><span style=\"color:#32145a\"><b>联动追踪</b></span>和<span style=\"color:#32145a\"><b>复刻·联动追踪</b></span>结束后清空保底计数。</li>\n<li><span style=\"color:red\">所有卡池都无法抽取</span><a href=\"/wqmt/%E7%A6%81%E9%97%AD%E8%80%85:%E8%B5%AB%E5%8D%A1%E8%92%82\" title=\"禁闭者:赫卡蒂\">赫卡蒂</a>。</li>\n<li>在多个限定同时UP的<span style=\"color:#be4bdb\"><b>返场·限定追踪</b></span>中，需要【锁定】1位限定禁闭者作为UP对象（可随时变更）。未【锁定】的禁闭者不会在返场卡池内出现。</li>\n<li>2025年4月后，每次<span style=\"color:#2a6e3f\"><b>统合追踪</b></span>消耗搜索令或异方晶的首个十连追踪会获得7折优惠，并且可选择【锁定】1位狂级禁闭者作为UP对象（可随时变更）。该卡池内获得的狂级禁闭者必为其指定范围内的狂级禁闭者，其他机制与常规追踪相同。</li></ul>\n</div></div>\n</div>\n<table class=\"wikitable\"
